history.requirements: Clamp finite numbers to inclusive lower/upper bounds; reversed bounds throw RangeError. Include boundary, interior, negative and error cases.

files.content: export function clamp(x,a,b){if(a>b)throw new RangeError();return Math.max(a,Math.min(b,x));}

tests.content: import test from 'node:test';import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {clamp} from '../src/clamp.js';test('boundary interior negative error',()=>{assert.equal(clamp(-4,-2,3),-2);assert.equal(clamp(4,-2,3),3);assert.equal(clamp(0,-2,3),0);assert.throws(()=>clamp(0,2,1),RangeError);});

# is-url-superb [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.com/sindresorhus/is-url-superb.svg?branch=master)](https://travis-ci.com/github/sindresorhus/is-url-superb)

> Check if a string is a URL

## Install

```
$ npm install is-url-superb
```

## Usage

```js
const isUrl = require('is-url-superb');

isUrl('https://sindresorhus.com');
//=> true

isUrl('unicorn');
//=> false
```
